objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: pamamahala sa sarili.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: managing your own work.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang angkop na kilos; hindi kailangang akuin ang lahat.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose an appropriate action; you do not have to take on everything.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makatotohanang pangako, maagang pagbalita at pagtitiyak ng resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Make a realistic commitment, report early and check the result.

sections.takeaway_fil: Alagaan ang sarili, unahin ang gawain at humingi ng suporta kung kailangan.
sections.takeaway_en: Care for yourself, prioritize work and seek support when needed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iulat ang totoong resulta at magsalita nang may paggalang.
sections.takeaway_en: Report the true result and speak respectfully.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang pagbabago bago iayon ang plano at pangako.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm the change before adjusting your plan and commitments.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng isang gawi, isulat ang makatotohanang layunin at repasuhin ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose one habit, write a realistic goal and review the result.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang self-management ay mga kilos na sinasanay at nirerepaso.
sections.takeaway_en: Self-management involves actions you practice and review.

check.prompt_fil: Mas maaga na ang pulong at may limang paanyayang natitira. Ano ang pinakamainam na gawin ni Malou?
check.prompt_en: The meeting has moved earlier and five invitations remain. What should Malou do?

options.fil: Tiyakin ang bagong oras, iulat ang natitira, at pagkasunduan ang makatotohanang pagbabago sa plano.
options.en: Confirm the new time, report what remains and agree on a realistic change to the plan.

options.fil: Sabay-sabay tapusin ang lahat at huwag magsabi ng hadlang upang patunayang maaasahan siya.
options.en: Finish everything at once and say nothing about difficulties to prove she is reliable.

options.fil: Sabihing tapos na ang lahat para hindi maantala ang pulong, saka tapusin ang natitira pagkatapos.
options.en: Say everything is complete to avoid delaying the meeting, then finish the rest afterwards.

check.feedback_fil: A: Pinakamainam. Tinitiyak ang pagbabago, tapat ang pagbalita at makatotohanan ang plano; naipakikita ang pag-angkop at pamamahala ng oras. B: Mabuti ang hangaring makatulong, ngunit ang sabay-sabay na gawain at pananahimik sa hadlang ay maaaring magdulot ng pagkakamali. Ang maaasahan ay nagsasabi nang maaga. C: Hindi tumpak ang ulat; kailangang malaman ng contact ang tunay na natitira upang makapagplano. Hindi katumbas ng pagtatapos ang pangakong gagawin ito mamaya.
check.feedback_en: A: Best. It confirms the change, reports accurately and makes a realistic plan, showing adaptability and time management. B: The wish to help is useful, but doing everything at once and hiding difficulties can lead to errors. A reliable worker speaks early. C: The report is inaccurate; the contact needs to know what truly remains to plan. A promise to finish later is not the same as completion.
